note: Compensation & Claims rules. Every vocabulary the register screens offer as a dropdown is in config/modules.d/leave-comp.json beside the field; what is here is what the hand-built screens compute with.

claims.note: The approval screen lists rows in a `pending` status and moves them to `approved` / `rejected`; the recovery statuses are what surface/Recoveries.php reads.

commission.note: rate_type: percent = rate_value % of the figure; fixed = rate_value rupees per row; slab = the rate of the band the WHOLE figure falls into (not marginal), bands ordered by upto, blank upto = top band; open = the typed amount is the payout. threshold: when set, a row pays only if collected / target * 100 >= threshold. TDS u/s 194H is deducted from the gross; the net is what pays.
commission.flat_tds_note: Owner, 29 Oct 2026: employees whose Salary Type is listed here have the flat TDS % (194H) of the commission entry deducted; every other Salary Type (Salary, Salary + Commission) has no flat TDS on the entry — the commission is added to salary and taxed on the income-tax slabs in payroll.

loan.note: An EMI schedule is principal / emi instalments from start_month; the last instalment is the remainder, never the standing EMI. Recovery is read from the closed payroll runs (component code LOAN-<id>), exactly as Recoveries does.

bank_pack.note: One CSV per approved run, in BankAdvice's generic shape: employee, name, account, ifsc, amount, of_which_arrears.
